name: iolitelabs-vscode-supply-chain-2026-03-28

rules.title: Legitimate pako@1.0.11 index.js SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the legitimate pako compression library — presence of this hash in incident response artifacts establishes the known-good baseline for tampering comparison.

rules.title: Tampered pako index.js SHA256 (IoliteLabs backdoor)
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the pako/index.js file injected with the IoliteLabs multi-stage backdoor dropper. Confirms artifact tampering.

rules.title: 7WhiteSmoke.msi installer SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the Chrome-impersonating MSI installer delivered via oortt.com. Contains the ntuser DLL keylogger.

rules.title: ntuser hook DLL SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the ntuser PE32 DLL extracted from 7WhiteSmoke.msi. Installs desktop-level input hooks via regsvr32 LOLbin execution.

rules.title: VSIX solidity-macos SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the malicious iolitelabs.solidity-macos VSIX package (v0.1.8).

rules.title: calc.bat Windows dropper SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the Windows batch dropper using environment variable string concatenation to reconstruct C2 URLs at runtime.

rules.title: doc.sh macOS dropper SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the macOS shell dropper that installs a LaunchAgent, bypasses Gatekeeper, and deploys architecture-specific binaries.

rules.title: doc macOS x86_64 binary SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the Intel Mac stage-2 exfiltration binary (57.8 MB pkg-packaged Node.js executable).

rules.title: doc1 macOS arm64 binary SHA256
rules.description: SHA256 hash of the Apple Silicon stage-2 exfiltration binary (7.9 MB pkg-packaged Node.js executable).

rules.title: IoliteLabs VSCode extension publisher ID
rules.description: Matches the iolitelabs.solidity publisher/extension namespace used in the compromised VSCode Marketplace extensions.

rules.title: rraghh.com C2 domain
rules.description: Primary C2 domain serving the Windows stage-1 dropper (calc.bat). Active since March 25, 2026.

rules.title: oortt.com C2 domain
rules.description: Secondary C2 domain serving the Windows stage-2 MSI (7WhiteSmoke.msi). Separate infrastructure from rraghh.com.

rules.title: WhiteSmoke MSI payload filename
rules.description: Filename of the Chrome-impersonating Windows installer. Appears as WhiteSmoke.msi or 7WhiteSmoke.msi in file system artifacts.

rules.title: 7WhiteSmoke MSI payload filename
rules.description: Full filename of the Chrome-impersonating MSI downloaded to %USERPROFILE%/Documents/.

rules.title: macOS Gatekeeper quarantine attribute
rules.description: The com.apple.quarantine extended attribute stripped by xattr -d in the IoliteLabs dropper to bypass Gatekeeper protection.

rules.title: cdn.rraghh.com C2 subdomain
rules.description: CDN subdomain serving macOS stage-1 dropper (doc.sh) and stage-2 binaries (doc, doc1).

rules.title: Spoofed Apple LaunchAgent plist
rules.description: The com.apple.system.updater.plist persistence artifact installed at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ to mimic a legitimate Apple system service.

rules.title: regsvr32 LOLbin execution
rules.description: The regsvr32.exe binary used with /s /i flags for Living-off-the-Land DLL execution of the ntuser hook DLL.

rules.title: TeamPCP tpcp.tar.gz exfiltration signature
rules.description: The tpcp.tar.gz archive filename associated with TeamPCP exfiltration across multiple supply chain attacks (litellm, telnyx, iolitelabs).

rules.title: rraghh.com/gt/calc.bat full C2 URL
rules.description: Full URL of the Windows batch dropper served from the primary C2 domain.

rules.title: cdn.rraghh.com/gt/doc.sh full C2 URL
rules.description: Full URL of the macOS shell dropper served from the CDN C2 subdomain.

description: Campaign-specific IOCs for the IoliteLabs VSCode extension supply chain attack (solidity-macos/windows/linux v0.1.8, March 2026). Covers SHA256 hashes of tampered artifacts, C2 domains (rraghh.com, cdn.rraghh.com, oortt.com), persistence artifacts, and payload filenames.
